items.summary: Fix the Aarti section (frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx) so that all aartis from static data (frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts) are correctly loaded and displayed as cards when the section is opened. The page must not show an error on load and must render all available aarti entries on all devices.
Add a graceful empty state UI to the Aarti section (frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx) in case no aarti data is available, showing a friendly Hindi message instead of an error or blank screen.
